title: Fake-DOM piece 3: move observation-ruling-delivery (170 tests) onto loadWorld
description:
Piece 3 of LIN-4271's approved plan. **Blocked on piece 0** (`getElementById`, `replaceChild`, and the `common.js` entities). It is its own piece because of its size (170 tests, 4,588 lines).

### Implemented

Piece 3 was implemented as approved: `tests/unit/observation-ruling-delivery.test.js` (170 tests) now runs on `loadWorld({ scripts: [] })` with `common.js` and `observation.js` run by hand, and its in-file fake DOM is deleted. PR: [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2307](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2307>) (squash `5f825eb6`). Deviations from the plan (`answerBulk` replaces the `yes.focus` auto-answer; `makeLi` wrappers kept; the `<select>`/`<option>` accessor is installed at element creation because the first write is on `<option>`) are recorded in the PR body. The plan's full text is preserved in the task snapshots, and the history is in the comment trail.

### Acceptance

* 170/170 pass with an empty name diff on the shared fake.
* The in-file shim, `FakeElement` and sandbox are deleted.
* The census entry is removed, and the file is in the consumer paragraph.
* The `select` outcome and the focus/blur mutation are recorded.

---

**Where the scope and design live.** Parent: **LIN-4271**. Read its description's `## Implementation Plan` (the approved plan, read at `473cc865`) and its `### Plan Review Verdict` comment `db80ceb2-14df-46c1-a163-29f74263f75e`, which has notes for the builder. Above that sit grandparent LIN-4255 and its course-change note `b4a44c2e-1ce0-4108-a524-eb94c3abfaee`. **The parent's approved plan is where this piece starts.** Follow it. Where the code shows the plan is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4271 (and on LIN-4255 if it changes the course-change note).

* Session fit: fits one session
* Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4271's approving plan-review (comment db80ceb2-14df-46c1-a163-29f74263f75e, rev 1)
* Grounding commit: `473cc865` (LinearViewer origin/main; the plan's read commit, still HEAD at breakdown on 2026-11-05, with no commits since to `tests/unit/helpers/`, the census, the fixture or the client files). Earlier beats read at `6d287518`.

comments.body:
**LIN-4282 beat 1/4: grounding and baseline.** Branch `feat/lin-4282-ruling-delivery-loadworld` cut from origin/main `aeb9d877`. No code changed yet.

**Drift since 14:37:47Z.** No commit touches the suite, `public/observation.js` or `public/common.js`. `fake-dom.js` changed in `8369461c` (LIN-4268), `82e75ee9` (LIN-4280) and `aeb9d877` (LIN-4279, piece 0). Piece 0 is on HEAD: `getElementById` (`fake-dom.js:459`), `replaceChild` (`:195`, which throws when `old` is not a child), and `NAMED` now includes `middot mdash hellip times` (`:72`). The census is now 47 entries, not 55. The suite is still listed at `fake-dom-census.test.js:84`. Nothing contradicts the slice of the plan.

**Baseline.** 170 tests, 34 suites, 170 pass, 0 fail, at `aeb9d877`. As in piece 1's PR, the `ℹ duration_ms` line is stripped from both sides of the diff.

**Inventory of suite-local fake-DOM constructs (all go in beat 2):**
- `FakeClassList` (`:65-79`) and `FakeElement` (`:81-163`). `FakeElement` has its own `children` array, `textContent` (own text only, never descendants), `attrs`, `listeners`, `click()`, a no-op `focus()`, a `replaceChild` that ignores a non-child, and a querySelector that matches bare `.class` and comma lists only.
- `makeLi()` (`:169-180`): detached FakeElements. These must be built from the world's `document`.
- `bulkConfirmElements()` (`:206-219`): the four `obs-ruling-bulk-confirm*` elements. `yes.focus` is monkey-patched to auto-click the answer.
- `makeSandbox()` (`:221-282`): an object-literal `document` (`createElement`, `addEventListener`, and `getElementById` over a detached `elements` map, which is a local shim), `vm.createContext`, then `vm.runInContext(withHarnessModels(common.js))`, the `ReplyDelivery`/`dispatchPrompt`/`api` overrides, and `observation.js`. The globals `confirm`, `escapeHtml`, `relativeTime`, `console` and `module` all move to `loadWorld({ scripts: [] })` plus hand-run sources. The `window` stub with its recording `_listeners` is test-owned and stays.
- The per-describe factories that build `new FakeElement(...)` hosts and pass them via `elements`: `makeRenderSandbox` ×3 (`:1357`, `:1436`, `:1479`), inline hosts (`:1703`, `:1762`, `:1801`), `makeBulkSandbox`/`selectAll` (`:1905`, `:2286`), `makeProgressSandbox` (`:2696`), `makeDraftSandbox` (`:4387`) and others. In total there are 75 `new FakeElement` sites and 107 `makeSandbox(` calls. Hosts must be real `id`'d elements attached to `document.body`, because `getElementById` and `focus()` both need connected nodes.

**Assertions that read fake internals, or rely on what the shim did not model:**
1. `sandbox.document.activeElement = box` (`:4423`). This becomes `box.focus()`.
2. Shelve hold (`:4434-4446`). The client's `reasonInput.focus()` (`observation.js:2608`) now really focuses. The focus clause (`:2144`) would therefore hold the row by itself, and the panel clause (`:2142`) would go untested. Add `reason.blur()` before the repaint, and prove it red by deleting `:2142`.
3. `reasonEl.children.length === 0` after a `textContent` write (`:1561-1565`). The old comment relies on the shim's setter clearing `children`. A real text node is not in `children`, so the assertion stays as it is. The comment gets rewritten, and the claimed `innerHTML +=` mutation should be re-proven red.
4. `head.innerHTML` regexes (`:4555-4557`). There is a serializer-difference risk here: real escaping and `attr=""`.
5. 15 `.click()` calls. The shared fake has no `element.click()`, so these become `clickOn` from `client-world.js`. The old `click()` was synchronous, and the sync `disabled` checks right after a press must still hold.
6. `selectAll.indeterminate` (`:1935`, `:2591`, `:2596`) is a plain expando. `checked` is modelled on `input` only.
7. Old `textContent` reads only the element's own text. The real fake concatenates descendants, so any `li`/container-level `textContent` read may shift. The leaf reads I checked (`.obs-ruling-feedback`, `-agree`, `-keep`, `-suggestion-label`) are unaffected.
8. Bulk confirm: `yes.focus = () => setImmediate(click)` (`:212`). The client calls `yes.focus()` (`observation.js:3380`). This instance override on a real element is the suite's stand-in for an operator. Beat 2 decides whether it stays as a test-owned answerer or becomes an explicit `clickOn` after the panel opens.
9. `sandbox.window._listeners.beforeunload` (`:2967`) is a test-owned `window` stub, not fake DOM, so it stays.

**The `<select>`/`<option>` `.value` case.** One test reaches it: "an open shelve panel and its reason survive a repaint" (`:4434`), through `openShelvePanel` (`observation.js:2583-2592`). The client writes `opt.value` on each `<option>` and then `durationSelect.value`, right after `createElement` and before any node is reachable from the test. The fake throws on both (`fake-dom.js:393`, "value is not modelled on <option>/<select>"). So "install the accessor before the first write" can only be done at element creation in that one world. This is a finding the plan did not foresee: the first write is on `<option>`, not `<select>`. Beat 2 records exactly how it is installed, and whether the held row keeps the node across the repaint. It should, because the panel is held, not rebuilt.

`common.js` entities: none missing. `mdash`, `hellip` and `times` are in `NAMED`, and the port will confirm this.

**LIN-4282 beat 2/4: the suite runs on the shared fake.** Local commit `5ffb0bc0` on `feat/lin-4282-ruling-delivery-loadworld`. Not pushed yet.

- **Result:** 170/170 pass. The spec name diff against the beat-1 baseline is empty, with `duration_ms` stripped as in piece 1. Assertions went from 541 to 544: none removed, one rewrapped, three added in the shelve test.
- **Deleted:** `FakeClassList`, `FakeElement`, the object-literal `document` (including the `getElementById` it read from a detached map) and `vm.createContext`.
- **How each sandbox is built now:**
  - Each sandbox is `loadWorld({ scripts: [] })`, with `withHarnessModels(common.js)` and then `observation.js` run by hand on `world.sandbox`.
  - The seeded hosts are real elements of the world's document. Each gets its id and is attached to `document.body`.
  - `makeLi(module)` draws the row in that sandbox's own document.
  - `.click()` becomes `clickOn` at 15 sites. These calls are not awaited, so the first listener still runs synchronously, as it did before.
- **Bulk apply (inventory item 8):** the `yes.focus` monkey-patch is removed. It overrode real focus and hid the press inside the fake. `answerBulk(module, run)` now presses Apply or Cancel explicitly with `clickOn`, once the panel is showing. The answer comes from the sandbox's `confirm`, or from the new `answer` option. It applies at 35 call sites, plus the two in-flight runs and the in-page question test.
- **`<select>`/`<option>`:**
  - The first write is `opt.value`, right after `createElement`. For that reason the accessor is installed at creation, by wrapping only that test's world `document.createElement`, for `option` and `select` elements.
  - **Observed:** the held row keeps the `<select>` node across the repaint. The test now asserts it is the same node with the 1-day value, so no reinstall was needed. The shared fake still refuses `select`.
- **Shared gaps found:** none. `fake-dom.js` is untouched.
- **Comment re-proven:** the rewritten `textContent`/`children` comment was checked by mutation. Changing `observation.js:2358` to `innerHTML +=` turns "the reason text is rendered via textContent…" red (169/170).
- **Census:** `fake-dom-census.test.js` now reports this file as "no longer hand-writes a fake DOM". This confirms the shim is gone. The entry is removed in the close-out beat.
- **Left for beat 3:** `document.activeElement = box` becomes `box.focus()`, `reason.blur()` goes in before the repaint, and the hold at `:2142` gets its mutation proof.

**LIN-4282 beat 3/4: mutations prove the replacements.** Local commit `76d95970`, on top of `5ffb0bc0`. Not pushed yet.

Before this beat, the test file still had `document.activeElement = box` and no `blur()`, because beat 2 left them. This beat made both edits:
- "a focused (still empty) answer box is not replaced" now calls `box.focus()` and asserts that `document.activeElement === box`.
- "an open shelve panel and its reason survive a repaint" now calls `reason.blur()` before the repaint and asserts that the reason is no longer focused. Opening the panel focuses the reason box (`observation.js:2608`), and a focused field holds the row by itself (`:2144`).

Each mutation ran the whole suite and then restored both files. `git diff public/` is empty.

| # | Mutation | Result |
|---|---|---|
| M1 | Delete the open-panel hold `observation.js:2142` | 169/170. ✖ an open shelve panel and its reason survive a repaint (`strictEqual`: the reason box was replaced) |
| M2 | M1, and the test without `reason.blur()` | **170/170 green**: the focus hold masks the panel hold, so **the blur is required** |
| M2b | Test without `reason.blur()`, client intact | 170/170 (control run) |
| M3 | Remove `giveSelectsAValue` from the shelve test | 169/170. ✖ an open shelve panel… (`shelve opens its reason panel`; the fake throws on `option.value`) |
| M4 | Focus hold `:2144` → `return false` | 169/170. ✖ a focused (still empty) answer box is not replaced |
| M5 | Test without `box.focus()` | 169/170. ✖ the same test |

**`<select>` outcome:** the accessor is needed (M3). The held row keeps the same `<select>` node across the repaint, which is asserted, so no reinstall was needed.

The other replaced fake-internals reads, each red under its own mutation:
- **`children.length` after `textContent`:** `:2358` changed to `innerHTML +=` turns "the reason text is rendered via textContent…" red.
- **`head.innerHTML` regexes:** dropping the title (`:2280`) breaks the title regex, and always showing the workspace (`:2281`) breaks "the raw workspace key is not shown". Both are in "the row names its task by id and title…".
- **`clickOn` instead of `.click()`:** without the Agree listener (`:3011`), "pressing Agree disables every control…" goes red.
- **`selectAll.indeterminate`:** with `indeterminate` always false (`:3102`), "the bulk bar's … tri-state track the selection" goes red.
- **`answerBulk` explicit press:** making the page's Apply listener answer Cancel (`:3388`) turns 27 bulk tests red.

Suite after the edits: 170/170 pass, and the name diff against the baseline is empty. The census still reports this file as no longer hand-writing a fake DOM. The entry and header are removed in beat 4.

**LIN-4282 beat 4/4: PR open, CI green.** PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2307. Head `80af7475`. Not merged.

- **Housekeeping:** the file leaves `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and joins the consumer paragraph in `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js` (commit `247340af`). The census rules are unchanged.
- **Merge from main:** LIN-4269 (#2306) landed mid-PR and conflicted in the consumer paragraph. I merged `origin/main` (`80af7475`) and kept both lists. The census goes from 38 to 37 and is green.
- **CI on `80af7475`:** all 7 checks pass. They are Unit tests, E2E shards 1-4, Secret scan, and CI success. CI was also green on the pre-merge head `247340af`.
- **Full unit suite, compared by failing test name:**
  - Merged head `80af7475`: 23,744/23,744.
  - Base `069585bb`: 23,744/23,744.
  - The failing-name diff is empty.
  - On the earlier pair, base `aeb9d877` had one unrelated flake, `LIN-4104 D2 …` in `task-mode-routes.test.js`. It was an `ENOENT` on a temp-file rename, and the file passes 41/41 three times when run alone.
- **Names and counts:** the plan's command `node --test --test-reporter=spec tests/unit/observation-ruling-delivery.test.js | sed -E 's/ \([0-9.]+ms\)$//'` gives an empty diff against the beat-1 baseline. `ℹ duration_ms` is dropped from both sides, as #2304 did. Before: 170/170. After: 170/170, both on the pre-merge head and after the merge.
- **Newer main:** main has since moved to `d537cd69` (LIN-4267, #2305). A local trial merge is clean, and the census, `fake-dom.test.js` and this suite pass at 300/300 with the list at 34. That head is not pushed. Before merge, the branch needs updating against main and CI re-running on that head, as the plan's rule says.
- **Focus/blur and select outcomes:** recorded in comment `bb960d0a` and in the PR body's mutation table. Removing the open-panel hold `:2142` is caught only with `reason.blur()` in place. The `<select>` accessor is needed, and was never reinstalled because the held row keeps its node.

## Autopilot stepper run summary (implementation, 4 beats, one warm session)

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2307 (head `80af7475`, not merged)

**Beats**
1. Ground and baseline: branch cut from `aeb9d877`, piece 0 confirmed on HEAD, 170/170 baseline, inventory (comment e1f74da8).
2. Migrate suite onto `loadWorld`: local fakes deleted, no assertions removed (commit 5ffb0bc0; comment 014b4399).
3. Focus/blur and select red mutations: 12 mutations all failed the suite as expected, including M2 showing `reason.blur()` is necessary; `public/` restored each time (commit 76d95970; comment bb960d0a).
4. Census and consumer-paragraph edits, full-suite comparison, PR and CI (comment 38c21ac0).

**Verified by me, not just reported**
- `gh pr view 2307`: OPEN, mergeStateStatus CLEAN, 7/7 checks SUCCESS (Unit tests, E2E shards 1-4, Secret scan, CI success).
- Changed files: tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js, tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js, tests/unit/observation-ruling-delivery.test.js. No `public/` change.
- Worker reports: before/after test-name diff empty at 170/170; full unit suite 23,744/23,744 on branch and base with identical failing-name sets.

**Plan departures (recorded in the PR):** `makeLi` and per-group helpers kept as thin wrappers; `answerBulk` replaces the `yes.focus` auto-answer; `clickOn` calls left unawaited; select `.value` accessor installed at element creation (the first write is on `<option>`, not `<select>`).

**What is left:** independent `review`, then `close-out`. The PR needs an update against main (now `d537cd69`) and a CI re-run before merge. Merge and Done are not done here.

## Review — LIN-4282

PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2307 · reviewed head `80af7475` (branch `feat/lin-4282-ruling-delivery-loadworld`), base `069585bb`; main now at `d537cd69`.

CI: green on `80af7475`. All 7 checks pass (Unit tests, E2E 1-4, Secret scan, CI success), mergeStateStatus CLEAN. That head is one commit behind main (`d537cd69`), so the CI result is for a head that is not the merge head yet. See the ledger.

**Scope versus the plan.** The PR changes 3 files, all in tests: the suite, `fake-dom-census.test.js` (−1 entry) and the consumer paragraph in the `fake-dom.js` header. `public/` and the fake are not changed. This matches the slice and the beat comments. Deleted from the suite: `FakeClassList`, `FakeElement`, the object-literal `document` with its `getElementById` map, and `vm.createContext`. A grep finds no `getElementById =`, no prototype patch, no `class Fake` and no `activeElement =`. The suite uses `loadWorld({ scripts: [] })` and then runs `withHarnessModels(common.js)` and `observation.js` by hand. All 15 `.click()` calls became `clickOn`. The plan departures are in the PR body (`answerBulk`, `makeLi` wrappers, `<select>` accessor at creation). Each one is justified, and none of them loosens an assertion.

**Staleness and regressions.** Since this ticket was created, the shared helpers and census changed only through the sibling pieces `8369461c`, `82e75ee9`, `aeb9d877`, `069585bb` and `d537cd69`, all of them adding to the list. Nothing reverted touches these files. The PR re-applies nothing that was reverted.

**Re-run by me:**
- Name diff (the plan's spec+sed command, with `duration_ms` dropped): base `aeb9d877` against head `80af7475` is **empty**, 170 tests, 34 suites, 170 pass.
- Trial merge of `origin/main` (`d537cd69`) into `80af7475`: auto-merges cleanly. `fake-dom-census` + `fake-dom.test` + this suite give **300/300**. The suite's name diff against the baseline is still empty. The file is absent from the census and present in the header paragraph on the merged tree. This was a local trial only and was not pushed.

**Mutation checks** (each one restored afterwards; `git status` is clean):
| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| M1: delete the open-panel hold (`observation.js:2142`) | 169/170. ✖ an open shelve panel and its reason survive a repaint |
| M2: M1, and the test without `reason.blur()` | 170/170 green. This shows the blur is required. |
| M2b: no blur, client intact (control) | 170/170 |
| M3: drop `giveSelectsAValue` | 169/170. ✖ the shelve test (the fake throws on `option.value`) |
| M4: focus hold `:2144` → `return false &&` | 169/170. ✖ a focused (still empty) answer box is not replaced |
| M5: test without `box.focus()` | 169/170. ✖ the same test |
| M6: Apply listener wired to `onNo` (`observation.js` askBulkApply) | 143/170. 27 bulk tests ✖. This shows `answerBulk` really drives the page's own buttons. |

These match the implementer's table in `bb960d0a`.

**`<select>` outcome (recorded):** the accessor is installed when `option`/`select` elements are created, by wrapping that one test world's `document.createElement`. The first write is `opt.value`, not `select.value`. The held row keeps the same `<select>` node across the repaint, and the test asserts this, so no reinstall is needed. The shared fake still refuses `select`.

**Isolated, or one of a class?** The class is "suites with a hand-written fake DOM". The remaining instances are LIN-4281, 4283, 4284 and 4285 and the rest of the census. Each is owned by its own sibling piece under LIN-4271, so all are **outside** this ticket. None of them is a ledger item.

**Checklist:** the tests cover the change. Each sandbox has its own world, so no state is shared. The suite is test-only, so it has no security or performance surface. The style matches the sibling pieces. One note, not a finding: `answerBulk` waits for exactly one `setImmediate` before it looks for the panel. A future client that asks later than that would make the test hang, which fails loudly. It would not pass silently.

No DECISION raised.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (the plan's move-PR rule: "before merge, update the branch against main and re-run CI on that head; `fake-dom-census` must be green on the merged head"). CI ran on `80af7475`, not on a merge with `d537cd69` (LIN-4267), which also edits the census list and the header paragraph. **Settle before the merge:** close-out merges `origin/main` into the branch and pushes. On that exact head, `ci-success` must be green and `node --test tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js` must pass. `observation-ruling-delivery.test.js` must be absent from `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and present in the `fake-dom.js` consumer paragraph next to the LIN-4267 additions. The suite must still give 170/170 with an empty name diff. My local trial merge already shows a clean auto-merge and 300/300, but CI has not run on it. If main moves again before the merge, repeat the same check on the new head.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. The port is complete and the mutation checks hold up when I re-run them. The only thing left is the plan's update-and-re-run-CI rule on the merged head.

## Close-out — LIN-4282

**Merged:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2307, squash commit `5f825eb6`, pinned with `--match-head-commit 37cd7686` (the head CI passed on). Review verdict: Approve, conditional on discharging one inside ledger item.

**Changes I made after the approval** (all test/header files, no `public/` change, no assertion touched):
- `34e814f5`: merged `origin/main` (LIN-4267 `d537cd69`). Clean auto-merge. Answers the review line "update the branch against main and re-run CI on that head".
- `4ed5d107`: main moved to `48d93c5c` (LIN-4284). Conflict in the `fake-dom.js` consumer paragraph; kept both lists.
- `37cd7686`: main moved to `6dd13617` (LIN-4283). Conflicts in the census list (both sides had each removed their own file, so both entries are out) and in the consumer paragraph (kept all three lists). Main did not move again after this.

**Ledger (1 item, inside): "CI must run on the merged head; census green; file absent from `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and present in the consumer paragraph; 170/170 with empty name diff."** Settled on the exact merge head `37cd7686`, which was on top of the then-current main `6dd13617`:
- CI run 42067091456: CI success, Unit tests, E2E shards 1-4 and Secret scan all pass. PR `mergeStateStatus` CLEAN at merge time. (CI had also gone green on `34e814f5` and `4ed5d107`, but main moved before either could be merged.)
- `fake-dom-census.test.js` + `fake-dom.test.js`: 130/130 locally on that head. The census has no `observation-ruling-delivery` entry. The `fake-dom.js` consumer paragraph lists it next to the LIN-4283 and LIN-4284 additions.
- The suite gives 170 tests, 170 pass, and the name diff against base (spec reporter, `ms` and `duration_ms` stripped) is empty. I re-ran this on all three merge heads.
- After the merge, on `5f825eb6`: census + `fake-dom.test.js` + this suite give 300/300.

**Outside items:** none. Review found nothing outside; the remaining hand-written fake-DOM suites are owned by the sibling pieces under LIN-4271. No follow-ups were filed. No rulings were open or raised.

**Deploy / post-deploy:** the change is tests-only (`public/` untouched), so there is no runtime deploy and nothing to run post-deploy. No named monitor was required. The post-merge `Tests` run on main for `5f825eb6` was only queued when I verified, so it is not counted as evidence here; the 300/300 above is a local run on the merged tree.

**Related tickets:** the parent LIN-4271 and siblings LIN-4281/4283/4284/4285 are other pieces and stay open. The blocker LIN-4279 was already Done.

**Description:** snapshot taken first (snapshot `16:20:51Z` matches the pre-prune text exactly), then the "Slice of the approved plan" and "Rules for every move PR" sections were replaced with a stub. Acceptance, session-fit, plan-review and grounding lines are kept word for word.

issue.title: Fake-DOM piece 0: shared-fake additions (getElementById, attr operators, replaceChild/Children, insertAdjacentHTML, entities, createElementNS, append/prepend) + client-world helpers
